findings.text: The test calls `decide_module` directly, so it passes even though a store populated by extractor version 5 reuses the old rows and still omits the macro instance. Fix: Bump `EXTRACTOR_VERSION` and update the incremental test to require re-extraction from a version 5 store.

The rule assumes a name-sized range distinguishes a class reference from a complete command, but Lean 4.34.1 gives an ordinary instance created by the single-token macro `makeDemo` that same full and selection range. Fix: Keep the instance when its range covers a complete parsed command and report the ambiguous case when the parser cannot establish its origin.

`NAME_ONLY` rejects the valid quoted class name `«my class»`, so an unparsed `deriving instance «my class» for Hue` is stored as a declaration whose entire text is the class name. Fix: Use Lean’s identifier parser for the name check and cover a quoted class name with an internal space.

The docstring says every instance with equal ranges outside a parsed deriving command is reported, while the new assertion requires a whole-command range to stay a declaration. Fix: Describe the expected result for both the class-name range and the whole-command range.

No test would fail if the new recovery instructions for a missing `macroScopes` field disappeared. Fix: Pass a record without `macroScopes` to `constant_facts` and assert that the error names the field, the rebuild command, and `--reader`.
